state.background: This is a corrected initial plan revalidation for B3k after an independent audit found the first boundary description left identical P42 checks active in Playwright. B3k continues the authorized speed-first migration of 90 final MAP-eligible E2E rows to Vitest Browser Mode. The latest user constraint says route dependence alone must not exclude a scenario. Actual component/browser slices are transferred while production route and integration checks remain in Playwright. The revised plan now removes the exact mapped E2E calls for every transferred assertion. The previous valid_as_defined plan result applied to the older boundary only and is preserved separately; this request evaluates the corrected boundary. Batch-1 actual-component Browser Mode tests are implemented but focused verification is pending; exact mapped Playwright expects were removed, and independent diff review confirms the retained integration boundaries.
acceptanceCriteria: Migrate exactly ten distinct final MAP-eligible rows in four batches of 2/2/3/3, with focused Browser Mode and independent diff review at each batch, then one consolidated E2E run after all ten rows.

Batch-1 row p45-b-range-change-107-e2e: transfer only P42-457/-458, the nominal and real rendered SVG bar-count-versus-finite-data-contract predicates, to actual CpiChart Browser Mode. Remove only those two identical count-vs-contract E2E expects. Keep production route readiness/hydration/data setup, route-fed chart presence, and nominal/real first-bar visibility in E2E; do not claim the fixture proves production projection parity.

Batch-1 row p45-b-tooltip-stack-total-81-e2e-t8-tooltip: transfer only P42-588/-591 tooltip-visibility predicates to actual SpendingBarChart with its real controller/handlers and browser pointer path. Remove only the two matching expect(tooltip).toBeVisible() calls. Keep production setup, real bar hover, food-row visible/absent, legend aria transition/click, pointer leave, and route-chart re-hover integration.

Other planned rows remain: SectionTabs scrollbar P42-505, overflow/scroll P42-506/-507, mask styles P42-508/-509; scroll-triggered tooltip dismissal P42-538/-539 (tap then actual scroll, close control hidden and cursor count zero); mobile series toggle P42-180/-183; dark-mode/tap tooltip and category text P42-187/-190; Earnings separator computed-style assertions P42-297/-309 only; and LazyMount initial absence/scroll mount P42-349/-350. Retain their documented production route, CSS freshness, platform, page, touch, and integration checks in E2E.
Do not count partial rows as full migrations in M. Keep immutable P42 attribution exact and avoid duplicate ownership of transferred predicates.
verification: Candidate audit confirmed ten unique final E=90 rows, no overlap with B3i/B3j, and no unit-owned assertion IDs.

Independent documentation and E2E diff review confirmed the corrected scope: only mapped P42-457/-458 and P42-588/-591 expects are removed, while the specified route and interaction integration remains.
Batch-1 Browser Mode tests exist for actual CpiChart count rendering and actual SpendingBarChart controller/re-hover visibility; focused tests and implementation JEV are pending.
The earlier plan JEV result is valid_as_defined but predates the precise E2E ownership correction and is preserved as historical evidence, not substituted for this revalidation.
knownConstraints: A route-specific candidate remains eligible when a real component fixture reproduces a useful browser-observable slice; do not exclude based on route dependence alone.
Do not transfer full production route, Flight/data hydration, engine-specific, or production page behavior into component fixtures.
Consolidated E2E cadence is ten touched scenario rows; do not run it before the tenth row.
B3k current cadence remains 0/10, A=123/E=90/M=1; all rows remain partial until their component and retained route boundaries are reviewed.
state.outputRequirement: Return a probability distribution over the listed choices and select one. For any non-pass reason, identify a case-specific finding, affected row or requirement, observed evidence, and either a concrete plan adjustment or exact additional evidence needed. Do not invent details.

plan.instructions: Does the corrected B3k plan support a safe and useful speed-first partial migration under the stated scope and acceptance criteria? Return a probability distribution.

criteria.valid_as_defined: The supplied plan supports the stated objective and boundaries.
criteria.requirements_mismatch: Requirements conflict with the intended migration; identify the requirement and correction.
criteria.missing_prerequisites_info: Prerequisite information is missing; identify exactly what is needed.
criteria.incomplete_implementation_info: The plan lacks implementation or evidence detail needed for acceptance.
criteria.implementation_issue: A planned implementation step has an issue; identify its location, evidence, and correction.
criteria.scope_violation: The plan exceeds or falls outside the agreed scope; identify the boundary and adjustment.
criteria.other: A material concern does not fit the categories; identify its location, evidence, and fix or needed evidence.
criteria.indeterminate: The supplied context cannot support a judgment; identify missing context if possible.
